title.narrative: Number of annual dropouts

description.narrative: Number per year.According to the Atlas Territorial de LAbandon Scolaire 20142018 (Atlas) p.16 published by the Conseil Superieur de lEducation, de la Formation et de la Recherche Scientific (CSEFRS), the average dropout rate in the primary cycle in rural areas is 4.8%. Reducing this rate by 10% to 4.32% in the schools benefitting from the interventions would be a substantial success and would be a larger reduction than the annual 0.1% that has occurred without intervention over the past few years. Naturally, the precise baseline in the schools benefitting from the intervention needs to be established by the PIQ TA consultants.
